name: Crossmaze – The Hub
intro: In the heart of SNN – The Hub, Begur, close to offices and to homes at SNN Raj Serenity, Prestige Song of the South and Windsor Troika.
description: Crossmaze – The Hub sits in the heart of Begur, close to SNN Raj Serenity, Prestige Song of the South, Windsor Troika and many offices nearby. Parents choose it for its well-kept, secure and enriching spaces.

Inside are well-lit classrooms, a fully equipped indoor play area and spotless restrooms. Alongside our preschool programs, we offer day care and after-school care built around the needs of working parents.
Thoughtful infrastructure, child-friendly facilities and strict safety routines make the centre a secure place for children to explore, learn, grow and let their imagination run free.
address: The Hub, in front of SNN Raj Serenity

centerHead.name: Mrs. Ruchika Bansal
bio: Mrs. Ruchika brings a rare mix of corporate experience and a deep passion for education to her role as Centre Head of Crossmaze – The Hub. She leads with structure, fresh ideas and a people-first approach that benefits children and staff alike.

A graduate who has completed the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) program, she also holds a Diploma in Advertising and Public Relations and a Diploma in Advanced Yoga and Face Yoga, and is certified in Jolly Phonics.

She spent over eight years in finance and operations at organisations including Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, KPMG and Genpact, leading and mentoring teams. Her love of yoga and mindfulness helps her create a calm, balanced and nurturing environment for every child.

name: Crossmaze – Neotown
intro: Our largest centre, in Neotown, Thirupalya: a favourite with busy parents who work at the many offices nearby.
description: Crossmaze – Neotown is our largest centre and a favourite with busy parents in the area. Close to many offices, it is clean, secure and full of life, with well-lit classrooms, spotless washrooms and fully equipped indoor and outdoor play areas.

Alongside our preschool programs, we offer day care and after-school care for working parents. With bright, airy classrooms, supervised play zones for each age group and engaging activity corners, it is a true home away from home.
Child-friendly facilities and strict safety routines make it a safe place for children to explore, learn and grow. Come and visit with your child to see the Crossmaze difference for yourself.
address: Site No. 3/4, opposite GM Infinite, Phase 1

centerHead.name: Mrs. Aishwarya Sharma
bio: Mrs. Aishwarya, Centre Head of Crossmaze – Neotown, brings rich experience in Montessori and child-centred learning, and a deep passion for nurturing young minds and a love of learning.
She holds a Master’s degree in English and Chemistry and a Bachelor of Education, and is a certified Montessori educator, with its focus on hands-on, personalised learning that sparks curiosity.

Before leading the centre, she played a key role at Crossmaze and knows our educational philosophy inside out. She is known for engaging, multi-level lessons that support each child’s own learning and development.

name: Crossmaze – SNN Greenbay
intro: Inside SNN Raj Greenbay in Electronic City: a favourite with parents who have demanding schedules at the offices nearby.
description: Crossmaze – SNN Greenbay, inside SNN Raj Greenbay in Electronic City, is a favourite with parents who have demanding schedules. Close to many offices, it offers a well-kept, secure and lively space for your child’s all-round development.
Well-lit classrooms and spotless restrooms make it a lovely place to learn, and fully equipped indoor and outdoor play areas support both thinking and physical growth.
Alongside our preschool programs, we offer day care and after-school care for working parents, all backed by child-friendly facilities and uncompromising safety.
address: G1, Commercial Complex (Creche), SNN Raj Greenbay
First Main Road, Electronic City Phase 2

centerHead.name: Mrs. Sheerin Seethara
bio: Mrs. Sheerin brings experience as a lecturer and preschool teacher, and a deep understanding of how children learn and grow, to her role as Centre Head.
Her MBA gives her a broad view of educational management, and her warm, approachable manner makes her a trusted guide for children and parents alike.
She believes in collaboration and excellence, and keeps communication open with children, parents and staff. A keen cook, she brings her love of food into workshops and events for the children.

name: Crossmaze – Neeladri Nagar
intro: In the heart of Electronic City, close to major offices and apartments, with an excellent adult-to-child ratio and a strong focus on transparency.
description: Crossmaze – Neeladri Nagar, in the heart of Electronic City, is a top choice for busy parents in the neighbourhood. Close to major offices and apartment complexes, it is a clean, cosy and magical place for little ones, with bright classrooms and sparkling play areas.
We run engaging programs for every age group with a lively curriculum, plus after-school care for working parents. Play zones are designed for each age group and full of exciting activities.
With one of the best adult-to-child ratios and a strong focus on transparency, your child’s safety always comes first.

centerHead.name: Mrs. Pallavi Priya
bio: Mrs. Pallavi Priya is a dedicated educator with a strong commitment to early childhood development. She holds a Master’s degree and a Diploma in Child Psychology, and has volunteered in schools in the UK, giving her a global view of education.

Formerly an Academic Counsellor at NIIT, Bengaluru, she has been part of Crossmaze for over two years, contributing to our curriculum and child development programs and organising cultural events, extracurricular activities and celebrations.
She loves painting, travelling, music and dance, and brings that creativity and enthusiasm to everything she does.

name: Crossmaze – Ananth Nagar
intro: In the heart of Ananth Nagar, close to offices and to homes at Concorde Epitome, Daadys Elixir, Prakruthi Solitaire and Mahendra Aarna.
description: Crossmaze – Ananth Nagar is a trusted choice for parents looking for quality early education and care. Close to major offices and residential communities such as Concorde Epitome, Daadys Elixir, Prakruthi Solitaire and Mahendra Aarna, it offers a well-kept, safe and enriching environment.
Bright, airy classrooms, a dedicated outdoor play area, a fully equipped indoor play area and clean, child-friendly restrooms make it a comfortable and engaging place to learn.
Alongside our preschool programs, we offer flexible day care and after-school care designed around the needs of working parents.
address: Ananth Nagar Phase 1, Kammasandra, Electronic City

centerHead.name: Dr. Megha Anand
bio: Dr. Megha Anand is an educationist with over 13 years of experience, respected for her commitment to inspiring a love of learning.

She combines deep expertise in educational leadership and child development with fresh approaches to early childhood education, and champions a holistic approach that values cognitive, social, emotional and physical growth.
She builds strong teamwork among teachers and involves parents closely in their child’s education, so that every child’s preschool years are joyful, enriching and meaningful.
